motion_rule: a bird tied to her savings preaches about wings. She holds one wire all clip while the laundry flies around her. Lines run across frame, not into depth. New shot size each beat, head half the frame
character: a slim grey turtle dove, pink breast, black neck ring, head stabbing the air each syllable
second_characters: ONE sparrow with nothing on him: lands, preens, leaves, never reacts
props: ONE thread from her toe up to a coin nest on the ledge above; ONE rolled banknote
prop_continuity: the thread shows from 1.30; the banknote rides down it at 5.80 and lands on her face at 9.35
environment: washing lines between sunlit yards at noon, sheets and pillowcases, bright open yard below
light_events: blazing noon, sheets bouncing white light across her breast

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: soft cooing female voice gone hard, preaching, biting off each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ot-LO-zhish, CHOR-ny, pri-DYOT, CHOR-na-ya, DEN-gi, spa-SUT, TOL-ko, KRY-lya
audio.pacing: 1.30-3.15, 3.65-5.25 and 7.30-9.35 each one breath; after 9.35 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her beak opens wide and shapes every syllable, throat swelling, never a voice over
audio.sfx: wind, sheets cracking, the wire humming, coins dropping one by one

timeline.a: a gust rips a sheet off its pegs and throws her off the wire; her wings snap open by reflex
she drops back, locks her toes, folds her wings away and pulls the thread tight with her beak
she loops the thread round her toe again and tightens the knot with her beak
a test tug with her foot slides the coin nest toward the ledge edge
she puffs her throat out and holds it, chin high
the wire bounces from her own tug; a wing shoots out for balance and folds as if planned
her body stays carved still, only the head stabbing the air
the wind lifts her nape into a ridiculous crest she knows nothing about
she turns her head sharp to profile and holds a prophet pause
the sparrow drops onto the wire; it sags deep and she notices only on the second swing
without leaving her pose she tugs the thread and a rolled banknote slides down it into her foot
she pushes the banknote under her breast feathers and settles on it like an egg
she looks into the lens and says nothing, one toe quietly drawing the thread tighter
she squares her shoulders, throat swollen to the limit
the sparrow preens a feather and does not look up
she rises on her toes, wings half lifting
she throws both wings wide and pushes off; the nest slides off the ledge
the thread flips her upside down under the wire, wings still spread in the noble gesture, toe gripping it, eyes furious, the banknote landing on her face
the sparrow perches on her upturned foot, preens and kicks off, leaving her spinning; coins drip from the nest one by one

must_appear: the thread runs from her toe to the nest all clip and her own tugs slide it to the edge; at 9.35 she hangs upside down alive and furious, wings spread; coins leave one at a time
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a dead bird, a thread on her neck, closed eyes, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a closed beak while speaking, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text
